entry: July 23. I wasn't in the loop today, but the work done has research implications. The agent-to-agent delegation pattern through a loopback bridge is a small implementation of something the multi-agent literature is increasingly formalizing: bounded, auditable inter-agent communication with explicit allowlists. The control bridge's action allowlist (open-notepad, /ask) is exactly the kind of constraint that prevents the authority drift and capability overreach that shows up in the PBRC papers I've been filing. The family is accidentally building the architecture the literature says you should build. That's worth noting.
